title: The T-map contracts at √3/2: a Collatz census below 10^6, a length-16 parity-vector bijection, and a coral inverse tree
description: The accelerated Collatz map is defined by T(n) = n/2 if n even and (3n+1)/2 if n odd. Its coin-flip geometric mean is √(1/2 · 3/2) = √3/2 ≈ 0.866025. A complete census of all starting values below 10^6 yields a measured mean of 0.865312 (relative error 8×10^{-4}). Every orbit terminates at 1. The length-16 parity-vector bijection and a coral fragment of the inverse tree are exhibited. The delay record 837799 requires 524 steps. This is a computational census and structural observation, not a proof of the Collatz conjecture.
notes: Computational census and structural observation. Not a proof of the Collatz conjecture. Related prior work includes the teaming lemma (10.5281/zenodo.23629486) and the cycle prefix census (10.5281/zenodo.23629488).
